methods.prompt: Shipped Scribe BuildSystemPrompt, default short instructions/style, no user vocabulary.
methods.context: Ollama's own setting; no num_ctx or hardware options sent.
methods.generation: Native streaming API for TTFT visibility, think=false, temperature=0.1, seed=42, max output=2048.
methods.cold: Unload the selected model before each request.
methods.warm_prefix: Keep model resident and reuse exact system/style prefix with varying public synthetic dictations.
methods.warm_changed_prefix: Keep model resident but prepend a unique neutral benchmark marker to break the common prefix; not a cache-off API.
methods.cold_with_readyness: Unload, send Scribe's empty-dictation readying with one output token, then rewrite. Rewrite time excludes preparation; both are recorded.
methods.quality: Fixed-reference exact match, not a blind judge score. Raw and sanitized results are reviewed separately.
methods.limits: Backend microbenchmark, not full microphone/recognition/injection latency; no cloud calls.
methods.confirmation: Four cases, stable-then-changed and changed-then-stable blocks. Constant and unique marker strings have equal length; per-case prompt token counts match. One-token priming recorded separately. No vocabulary.
